summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to announce publication of a drawdown prospectus for a new debt issuance under its existing Debt Issuance Programme. The issue comprises CNY2.5 billion 1.950% fixed-rate notes due 2030 and CNY1.5 billion 2.300% fixed-rate notes due 2034, approved by the Financial Conduct Authority. This is a routine capital markets transaction — a drawdown of notes under a shelf programme — not a special-situation event. The prospectus is available for viewing on HSBC's website and filed with the National Storage Mechanism. No special-situation characteristics (merger, tender, restructuring, etc.) are present; the filing is purely procedural for debt issuance.
